cases.title: Initiate drag event and capture product title and price
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') from the product list and verify that the drag event successfully captures the product's title ('product-title-1') and price ('product-price-1') for transfer.

cases.title: Verify non-draggable elements do not initiate drag events
cases.description: Attempt to initiate a drag event on an element without the 'draggable=true' attribute and verify that the system does not capture any product title or price for transfer.

cases.title: Drop product item into drop area to update cart display
cases.description: Drag a product item (data-testid='product-item-1') and drop it into the designated drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the cart display automatically updates with the product title appearing in .box2, the unit price in .box3, and the quantity in .box1.

cases.title: Drop repeated products into drop area to increment quantity
cases.description: Drag and drop the same product item (data-testid='product-item-1') multiple times into the drop area (id='div1', data-testid='drop-area'). Verify that the system supports repeated products and increments the quantity accordingly in .box1.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price for multiple cart items
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly sums the prices of all products in the cart, formats the total to two decimal places with the currency symbol, and displays it in the div with id='allMoney'.

cases.title: Calculate and display total price for a single cart item
cases.description: Verify that the system correctly calculates and displays the total price formatted to two decimal places with the currency symbol in id='allMoney' when only a single product is present in the cart.

opinions.feedback: The proposed test cases are generally well-structured and cover the core requirements of dragging, dropping, cart updates, and total calculation. However, case G-002 tests a negative scenario ('non-draggable elements') that is not specified in requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1, making it an unsupported edge case. Furthermore, cases G-005 and G-006 can be combined into a single robust test case covering both single and multiple cart items.
confirmed_blockers: Case G-002 tests non-draggable elements which is not mentioned in requirement e2edev_bench_01-R-1.
